thesis: The page is a hand-drawn St. Johns River route: the reader travels downstream from Riverside to the Beaches, and at every stop a window elevation drawn to that neighborhood's build years lifts its lower sash open as you arrive.

signature.name: River Route Stops + Lifting Sash
signature.summary: One blue SVG river line (stroke 3px, gentle meanders) runs down a left gutter column through the page; each stop is a brick-red mile dot (hollow until reached, fills on arrival), a condensed caps stop name, a 'Built 1909–1930' year band and a line-drawn window elevation (6-over-1 double-hung, steel casement, ranch slider, impact single-hung, French door) whose lower sash slides up 38% when the stop is reached. Variations: hero (the line starts under the h1 and the marquee is a bank of elevations), stops story (5 stops, sash lifts), tool (style-by-house-age decade tabs move the dot along a mini river and redraw the elevation), proof (reviews moored at their town's stop dot on a horizontal reach), prices (each row carries its tiny elevation glyph), footer (the line widens into the river mouth at the Atlantic, the 10 areas as stops).

palette.family: Spanish Moss + St. Johns Blue + Brick Stop

layoutMoves: left gutter route column (2 of 12 cols) that the river line lives in across stops, proof and footer
centered statement hero with a drawn-elevation marquee instead of photos
horizontal river reach for reviews (scroll-snap rail) breaking the vertical route
duotone cyanotype-blue full-bleed break of the one house photo

motion.intro: h1 line-mask rise 700ms, then the route line draws 0→first stop (600ms) while the elevation marquee starts at 0 speed and eases to 40px/s over 1.2s; skippable, text readable at t=0.
